Karma: ince doku piramitten, ton ve geçi: Hybrid: fine texture from the pyramid, tone and transitions from the depth map; best for most shots. Detail: sharpest result, prone to halos. Smooth: cleanest transitions, for products and glossy surfaces.

Doğal: gözün gördüğüne yakın. Canlı: dah: Natural: close to what the eye sees. Vivid: richer colour and local contrast. Dramatic: strong detail and contrast, for architecture and cloudy skies.
Kareler arasında hareket eden insan, ara: Prevents moving people, cars or leaves from leaving semi-transparent double images; the mid exposure is used in those areas.
Küresel izdüşüm, görüntüyü kürenin iç yü: Spherical projection places the image on the inside of a sphere and unrolls it to a flat map; the output is flat but can be explored from inside the sphere in a 360° viewer. 360° photo metadata (GPano) is written to the file.
